messages:
carol (auditor): Need evidence for RBAC change on 2026-02-15 (svc-admin removed from team-data) plus the KMS rotation that re-encrypted CVA artifacts. Deliverables: change ticket, CloudTrail slice, KMS rotation record (old->new), re-encrypt manifest with checksums, and chain-of-custody. Also include verification steps.

ryan (sec-eng): Ticket = RDW-4821. Change applied via terraform pipeline. Approver = nina, executor = dave. We'll export CloudTrail events and the pipeline run logs.

nina (infra): CloudTrail slice uploaded: s3://redwood-audit-exports/3119991111/cloudtrail-2026-02-15.json.gz (object-lock enabled). Query used: lookup events for PutRolePolicy / RemoveRoleFromInstanceProfile + CodePipeline execution events.

dave (devops): Re-encrypt job = recrypt-job-2026-02-16. Rewrap manifest: s3://redwood-cva-manifests/recrypt-2026-02-16/manifest.json (entries include s3_key, sha256, old_key_arn, new_key_arn). Example manifest line: { "s3_key": "cva/2026/obj-12345.enc", "sha256": "8b1a995...", "old_key": "arn:aws:kms:...:key/abcd...", "new_key":"arn:aws:kms:...:key/fedc..." }

nina (infra): KMS new key ARN = arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:111122223333:key/fedcba98-7654-3210-ffff-0123456789ab (rotation timestamp 2026-02-16T03:10:00Z). IAM policy snippet granting recrypt-service-role kms:ReEncrypt*, kms:Decrypt included in export.

carol (auditor): Need proof RBAC removal blocked access after change (AccessDenied event) and the policy showing who can call ReEncrypt/Decrypt. Also include incident tie: INC-2109.

nina (infra): Pulled CloudTrail event where arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/svc-admin received AccessDenied for s3:GetObject at 2026-02-15T13:02:11Z — exported in same cloudtrail file. IAM policy snippet in s3://redwood-audit-exports/3119991111/iam_policy.txt.

dave (devops): Chain_of_custody.md will include RDW-4821, RDW-4799 (CI mis-scope), approver/executor list, recrypt-job id, and evidence-bundle path. IR note: INC-2109 summary included, root cause = mis-scoped CI role, no confirmed exfil, keys rotated as precaution.

ryan (sec-eng): Verification steps (README included): 1) Download manifest and object; 2) sha256sum object and compare to manifest; 3) check CloudTrail event IDs/timestamps correlate to RDW-4821; 4) verify KMS key ARNs with aws kms describe-key. Example commands:
aws s3 cp s3://redwood-cva-manifests/recrypt-2026-02-16/manifest.json ./manifest.json
aws s3 cp s3://redwood-cva-artifacts/cva/2026/obj-12345.enc ./obj-12345.enc
sha256sum obj-12345.enc
aws kms describe-key --key-id arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:111122223333:key/fedcba98-7654-3210-ffff-0123456789ab

ryan (sec-eng): Deliverables uploaded to s3://redwood-audit-exports/3119991111/: RDW-4821.pdf, cloudtrail-2026-02-15.json.gz, iam_policy.txt, kms-rotation-log.json, recrypt-manifest.json, sample-obj-12345.enc, chain_of_custody.md, inc-2109-summary.pdf, README_verification.md

evidence-bot: export ready: s3://redwood-audit-exports/3119991111/rbac-kms-handback.zip (size=17MB), manifest_sha256=3b7f4d9e2c1a9a0f

carol (auditor): Thanks — I'll pull the bundle and run the checks tomorrow. If I need temporary decrypt/verify rights for KMS signatures I'll file an access request.

ryan (sec-eng): noted, ping here if you need anything else.
